requirements.requirement: Retain actual section77 and both title topics: thin-lens formula and lens magnification. No preceding n76 body enters this unit. Do not declare the magnification topic complete before actual accepted continuation.

Retain the three distinct variables: object-to-lens distance d, image-to-lens distance f, and focal length F. State their thin-lens/paraxial context. Never interchange lower-case f with capital F; any necessary modern signed convention must be explicit and consistent with subsequent accepted source, not guessed before that source arrives.

Retain the fig179-bound derivation from similar triangles ABF and DOF, with |OD|/|AB|=|OF|/|BF|, |OD|=|A_1B_1|, and numbered (6.15): |A_1B_1|/|AB|=|OF|/|BF|=F/(d-F). Keep all absolute-value pairs, subscripts, original numerator/denominator, and the distinct points. An independent image inventory, not the prose, establishes the actual point/ray layout.

Retain the second similarity COF with A_1B_1F, |A_1B_1|/|OC|=|B_1F|/|OF|, |OC|=|AB|, and numbered (6.16): |A_1B_1|/|AB|=(f-F)/F. Distinguish lower-case image distance f from focal length F and retain all absolute values and subscripts.

Retain equating the right sides of (6.15)/(6.16), F/(d-F)=(f-F)/F, then F^2=fd-fF-Fd+F^2, fF+Fd=fd, and division by Ffd. Preserve original formula tokens and their order; modern explanatory wording must make the converging-real-image construction and nonzero denominators clear without treating this diagram as all possible signed-image cases.

Retain numbered (6.17), 1/d+1/f=1/F, and (6.18), 1/d+1/f=D. Do not add a completed magnification formula or a missing continuation from memory. Future statements about virtual image distance, diverging-lens focal length, optical power and magnification require actual accepted continuation and explicit modern sign conventions.
